mapper.select: SELECT order_id, username, student_name, dish_id, dish_name, portion, price, `date`, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at FROM canteen_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO canteen_order (order_id, username, student_name, dish_id, dish_name, portion, price, `date`, create_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{username}, #{studentName}, #{dishId}, #{dishName}, #{portion}, #{price}, #{date}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('ORD', LPAD(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(order_id, 4) AS UNSIGNED)) + 1, 1), 4, '0')) FROM canteen_order
SELECT order_id, username, student_name, dish_id, dish_name, portion, price, `date`, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at FROM canteen_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT order_id, username, student_name, dish_id, dish_name, portion, price, `date`, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at FROM canteen_order WHERE username = #{username} ORDER BY create_time DESC, order_id DESC
